text:
maria: Taking the handoff for night oncall — handing to @jonathan for 18:00 UTC shift. Quick summary of outstanding POSTMORTEM ENG-231 remediations so the night crew has context. TL;DR: 2 closed, 1 needs smoke verification, 2 need follow-up. Details below.

jonathan: Thanks. Quick Q — which items touch smart routing / fallback config? And is the canary for model-fallback still disabled?

maria: Good Q. Short list: 
1) ENG-231-12 — config drift detection (agent config validation): FIXED and deployed to prod 2026-03-16T19:12Z, ticket ENG-231-12.
2) ENG-231-7 — batching regression (incorrect batching kernel): rolled back, hotfix deployed 2026-03-16T20:01Z, needs perf smoke test (see Alex).
3) ENG-231-9 — KV cache cleanup: PR merged, rollout in progress (2/4 nodes). Need to verify cache consistency after rollout.
4) ENG-231-15 — alerts tuning: thresholds adjusted but alert rule still references old metric name (workaround applied). Requires a follow-up change to alert rule.
5) ENG-231-21 — runbook + postmortem docs: draft ready, needs signoff and publish.

Notes on smart routing: only ENG-231-9 touches routing fallback heuristics indirectly (kv cache TTL adjustments). Canary for model-fallback remains disabled until KV rollout completes.

jonathan: Understood. I will monitor the KV rollout and alert behavior. If I see >5% increase in tail latency or sustained errors, I'll rollback the rollout and notify. :eyes: 

alex: I can run the perf smoke test for ENG-231-7. Plan: 30m steady-state load to dedicated-stage region, 8 concurrent clients, 512 token avg. Will post results here. Want me to run now?

maria: Yes please — run against dedicated-stage (region: us-west-2-dedicated-stage). Use the test script below. If smoke is green, mark ENG-231-7 as VERIFIED. If any p95 regression > 10% mark as REOPEN.

alex: Running now. Command: ```bash
./scripts/smoke_load.sh --target dedicated-stage --clients 8 --duration 30m --tokens 512 --tag eng-231-smoke
```

oncall-bot: Rotation notice — jonathan is now primary oncall (start 2026-03-17T18:00:00Z). Reply 'ack' to confirm.

jonathan: ack. Will keep an eye on rollout, alerts, and the smoke test results. I'll also verify ENG-231-12 closure and confirm no config drift alerts for the window.

sam: FYI — customer-x reported a p99 tail spike earlier today that lines up with the batching rollback window. If Alex's smoke shows regressions, we should treat ENG-231-7 as a reopen candidate and prioritize a remediation patch.

maria: Noted. Alex — please paste the smoke test summary (p50/p95/p99, error rate) in this thread. If green, I'll close runbook task tomorrow morning and mark alerts follow-up as scheduled for next sprint.

jonathan: I'll post a quick check in ~15m after the KV rollout reaches 3/4 nodes. If metrics look good, I'll let the canary for model-fallback remain disabled and we continue monitoring. If anything suspicious, I'll page the oncall rotation.

alex: Smoke finished. Summary: p50 48ms, p95 210ms (baseline stage p95 205ms, +2.4%), p99 420ms (baseline 410ms, +2.4%), error rate 0.08% (baseline 0.05%). No obvious regression >10%. Logs show a small bump at 00:12Z that coincides with a GC event on node inference-rc-03. Full raw output attached to ticket ENG-231-7.

maria: Great — that looks within tolerance. I'll mark ENG-231-7 as VERIFIED and update the ticket. 

jonathan: KV rollout status check (quick curl): ```bash
curl -s "https://infra.internal/api/rollouts?service=inference" | jq '.[] | select(.name=="kv-cache-cleanup")'
```

jonathan: Rollout now 3/4 nodes (progress 75%). No alert fires in the last 10m. I'm going to watch for 30 more minutes then report back.

sam: Thanks — if jonathan sees the customer-x spike reappear, reopen ENG-231-7 and page the paging list.

maria: Thanks everyone. Handoff checklist: pager on, Slack notifications enabled, escalation doc link here: https://confluence.redwood/inference/oncall-escalation. I'll check in tomorrow AM to finalize docs and close remaining small followups.

jonathan: Ack — will post final status at 2026-03-17T19:15Z or earlier if anything changes.

maria: Closing note: if anything needs to be reopened from tonight's monitoring, prefix the ticket with REOPEN/ENG-231 and tag @maria and @sam so we can prioritize. Good night! :night_with_stars:
